clipzo.welcome: Hi! I can answer questions about Clipzo, a mobile videography and cinematic reel production agency serving Mangaluru, Bengaluru, Kerala, and Vizag.

answers.question: How fast is reel delivery?
answers.answer: Most standard reels are delivered within 10 minutes of the shoot. Same-day delivery is available for selected event packages.

answers.question: What packages do you offer?
answers.answer: Clipzo packages are: Basic Reel Making hourly ₹1,999 (1 cinematic iPhone reel, 1-hour location shoot, under 60 seconds, same-day delivery on request); Basic Reel Making half-day ₹4,999 (event coverage, highlights reel under 90 seconds, same-day delivery on request, one complimentary story edit); High-end Reel Making hourly ₹3,499 (professional iPhone shoot, Premiere Pro and After Effects editing, under 60 seconds); and High-end Reel Making speed-ramp ₹4,999 (2-hour shoot, After Effects editing, under 60 seconds, one complimentary story edit). Extra shooting time is ₹500 per hour.

answers.question: Do you travel to my location?
answers.answer: Clipzo is a mobile videography and cinematic reel production agency operating across Mangaluru, Bengaluru, Kerala, and Vizag. Travel within 10 km of Mangaluru city is complimentary. Locations beyond 10 km have a ₹500 travel charge.

answers.question: What is your office location?
answers.answer: Clipzo operates from Shree Mangaladevi Palace, Clock Tower, Hampankatta, Mangaluru. The mobile production team operates across Mangaluru, Bengaluru, Kerala, and Vizag. Suggested message: Hi Clipzo, I would like to visit your Mangaluru office. Please share the best time to meet.

answers.question: What are your working hours?
answers.answer: Clipzo is available Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

answers.question: How can I contact Clipzo?
answers.answer: Call or WhatsApp +91 95916 31027, or email clipzoindia@gmail.com.

answers.question: What production services do you offer?
answers.answer: Clipzo offers Traditional Videography from ₹7,990, Candid Videography from ₹11,990, Traditional Photography from ₹7,990, Candid Photography from ₹11,990, and Drone Videography from ₹5,999.

answers.question: What editing services do you offer?
answers.answer: High-end PC Editing Services start at ₹2,499 and include Premiere Pro or After Effects, a reel under 60 seconds, colour grading, transitions, motion graphics, and 1080p or 4K output. Cinematic Highlight Services start at ₹4,999 and include Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve, highlights under 5 minutes, colour grading, audio cleanup, and 1080p or 4K output.

answers.question: What gear do you use?
answers.answer: Clipzo uses the latest iPhone series for reel making, with professional cameras, lighting, and editing options available for premium productions.

answers.question: Can I request revisions?
answers.answer: Two revisions are included. Additional revisions or major changes can be arranged at an extra charge.

answers.question: How do I book Clipzo?
answers.answer: You can start by sending your project details through the enquiry form or contact Clipzo on WhatsApp. A 50% non-refundable advance confirms a booking, and the balance is due immediately after the shoot.

academy.welcome: Hi! I can answer questions about Clipzo Academy, learning areas, cohorts, and enrollment.
quickQuestions: What can I learn at Academy?

answers.question: What can I learn at Academy?
answers.answer: Clipzo Academy focuses on cinematic editing, camera craft, direction and story, and portfolio mentorship. Learning is guided by active filmmakers, editors, and visual storytellers.

answers.question: How do I enroll?
answers.answer: Use the enrollment form in the Academy section of this website. Click Open Google Form, complete your details, and submit the form there.

answers.question: What is the cohort format?
answers.answer: Academy offers 12-week cohorts with live studio practice and 1:1 mentor reviews.

answers.question: What is the Academy approach?
answers.answer: The Academy message is One Goal • One Decision • One Direction: choose your path, commit to your craft, and move with purpose.

answers.question: Where is Clipzo Academy?
answers.answer: Clipzo Academy is part of the Clipzo creative world operating from Mangaluru. The website lists the Clipzo location at Shree Mangaladevi Palace, Clock Tower, Hampankatta, Mangaluru.

answers.question: What are the Academy timings?
answers.answer: The published Clipzo operating hours are Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Specific Academy class schedules are shared with enrolled students or through the enrollment form.
